name: driver-jitter
description: Driver-output edge-to-edge timing across an 18-bit full-speed pattern with varied run lengths. Engineering data only -- spec/usb2-device-phy.md §8.2 forbids a pass/fail against an unconfirmed jitter number.
claim: spec/usb2-device-phy.md#82-what-gets-measured-and-against-which-section row 'Driver-output timing jitter' -- recorded as ENGINEERING DATA WITH NO SPEC LIMIT ATTACHED, which is what that row's own note mandates: the repo has no confirmed numeric USB 2.0 source-jitter limits from the physical specification text, and §8.2 explicitly says sim/ 'may record measured jitter as engineering data without a spec citation attached' until that pull happens. No jitter measurement below carries a min/max limit; the single check present is a harness-integrity spread floor, not a spec claim.

tprop_ns.description: harness integrity, NOT a spec row: the driver's propagation delay to the first differential crossing is strongly PVT-sensitive, so a flat value across the grid would mean the corner .lib sections or .temp never took effect. spec/usb2-device-phy.md §8.2 forbids attaching a numeric pass/fail to any jitter quantity in this record until the USB 2.0 source-jitter limits are pulled from the physical text, so no jitter measurement here carries min/max limits.
